units.name: boot -O0
units.evidence: startup object built at -O0: unoptimised frames throughout; the fixed-O0 orphan-constant matches 08000460, 0800052C, 0800058C, 08000670, 08000788.

units.name: agb_flash FLASH512_V130
units.evidence: Nintendo agb_flash FLASH512_V130: the library's only ID string; pret builds agb_flash with -O, SAT-R/sa2 with -O1; SA2's public C reproduces all 24 functions at -O1, 15 differ at -O2.

units.name: libgcc dp-bit
units.evidence: libgcc dp-bit.o (fp-bit-base.c without FLOAT): __pack_d through __truncdfsf2 in source order; pret/agbcc builds libgcc with old_agbcc -O2; __unpack_d is byte-identical only under old_agbcc.

units.name: m4a.c (MusicPlayer2000)
units.evidence: Nintendo m4a.c (MusicPlayer2000): MidiKeyToFreq through DummyFunc in pret/SAT-R sa2 source order, after m4a_1.s (ends at 0x08145098); pret and sa2 build m4a.o with old_agbcc -O2. sa2's public text (mono build, FFTA addresses) compiled as one file with old_agbcc reproduces the whole range byte-for-byte, all 58 functions; under agbcc 21 of them differ. Leaf functions with a branch return by bx lr without saving lr (6 here; every such game-code leaf saves lr); ClearModM is byte-identical only under old_agbcc.
